name: @reventlessdev/online-shop-hybrid-platform-in-memory
description: Online Shop Hybrid example — full platform with Catalog + Ordering plugins (in-memory)

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build -- -with-deps
scripts.dev:ui: [ -d reventless-ui ] && npm --prefix reventless-ui run dev:ui || dev-app
scripts.dev:full: concurrently --names backend,ui --prefix-colors cyan,magenta 'npm run serve' 'npm run dev:ui'
